name: Accordion
description: Expandable content sections that can operate in single or multiple open modes. Features animated icon rotation and full keyboard accessibility.

keyboard.ArrowDown: Moves focus to the next accordion header
keyboard.ArrowUp: Moves focus to the previous accordion header
keyboard.Home: Moves focus to the first accordion header
keyboard.End: Moves focus to the last accordion header

mode.description: Whether one or multiple sections can be open simultaneously

defaultOpen.description: Index of the section to open by default (-1 for none)
